ruleBookInfo.init:
<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + o('#bookIntro').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>

<js>
(function(){
  var h=(baseUrl.match(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/)||[''])[0];
  if(!h){return [];}
  var html1=(typeof src!=='undefined' && src) ? src : null;
  var list=[];
  if(html1===null){
    try{html1=java.ajax(baseUrl);}catch(e0){html1="";}
  }
  if(!html1){return [];}
  try{
    var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(html1));
    var els=doc.select('ul.bookdetails-catalog-list li');
    for(var i=0;i<els.size();i++){
      var el=els.get(i);
      var a=el.select('a').first();
      if(!a){continue;}
      list.push({title:a.text(),url:h+a.attr('href'),isvip:el.attr('class').indexOf('bookdetails-cataloglist-vipitem')>=0});
    }
  }catch(e1){
    var re=/<li class="[^"]*bookdetails-cataloglist-item[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*<a href="(\/book\/\d+\/\d+\.html)"[^>]*title="([^"]*)"/g;
    var mm;
    while((mm=re.exec(html1))!==null){
      list.push({title:mm[2],url:h+mm[1],isvip:false});
    }
  }
  return list;
})()
</js>

 - 如果该书源网站你在手机浏览器上也是无限循环人机验证，那么说明是你系统的 WebView 版本太低了，建议升级到最少 11x 版本。
 - 如果该书源网站你在手机浏览器能通过人机验证，那么说明是你手机系统 WebView 内核版本与当前书源所用的 UA 中的 WebView 版本信息相差过大，请将下方的【请求头】规则中 `Chrome/115.0.4664.104` 的 115 这个大版本号修改为你手机系统的 WebView 内核版本（比如你是 96.0.x.x 那就将 115 改成 96，后面的小版本号不影响）。

<js>
(() => {
	try {
		data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())
	} catch (err) {
		data = {}
	}
	sessionID = data.sessionID||"";
	if (!sessionID) {
		chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789";
		charsLength = chars.length
		for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
			sessionID += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charsLength))
		}
		data.sessionID = sessionID
		source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data))
	}
	return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID=" + sessionID,
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 13_3_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/13.0.5 Mobile/15E148 Snapchat/10.77.5.59 (like Safari/604.1)"
	})
})()
</js>

<js>
(() => {
	try {
		data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())
	} catch (err) {
		data = {}
	}
	sessionID = data.sessionID||"";
	if (!sessionID) {
		chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789";
		charsLength = chars.length
		for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
			sessionID += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charsLength))
		}
		data.sessionID = sessionID
		source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data))
	}
	return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID=" + sessionID,
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 13_3_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/13.0.5 Mobile/15E148 Snapchat/10.77.5.59 (like Safari/604.1)"
	})
})()
</js>

<js>
(() => {
	try {
		data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())
	} catch (err) {
		data = {}
	}
	sessionID = data.sessionID||"";
	if (!sessionID) {
		chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789";
		charsLength = chars.length
		for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
			sessionID += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charsLength))
		}
		data.sessionID = sessionID
		source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data))
	}
	return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID=" + sessionID,
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 13_3_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/13.0.5 Mobile/15E148 Snapchat/10.77.5.59 (like Safari/604.1)"
	})
})()
</js>

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var bookid = baseUrl.match(/novel\/(\d+)/)[1];
//书评发送
const bookva = book.getVariable("custom");
if (bookva && bookva != "") {
    if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
        const commenturl = `${GetUL()}/home/comment/add.html`;
        let body = `content=${bookva}&type=novel&mid=${bookid}`;
        
        try {
            const code = String(java.getVerificationCode(`data:image/svg+xml;base64,${codesvg}`));
            
            if (code == "评论" || /^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                if (/^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                    body += `&pid=${code.match(/(\d+)/)[1]}`;
                }
                
                const headers = { "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest" };
                const response = java.post(commenturl, body, headers).body();
                java.toast(JSON.parse(response).msg);
            } else {
                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(40);
                java.toast('请按图片要求填写');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            java.log(err);
        }
    } else {
        java.toast("未登录，请登录后操作");
    }
    book.putCustomVariable("");
}

try {
    sourceinfo = source.getLoginInfoMap();
    sourceinfo['书籍ID'] = bookid;
    if (bookid) {
        source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(sourceinfo));
    }
    $ = _ => String(java.getString(_));
    img = /^https?/.test($('[property$=image]@content')) ? $('[property$=image]@content') : GetUL() + $('[property$=image]@content');
    list = {
        "ID": bookid,
        "img": img,
        "name": $('[property$=book_name]@content'),
        "author": $('[property$=author]@content'),
        "info": $('[property$=description]@content').slice(0, 45),
        "url": "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src=" + baseUrl
    }
    source.put("list", JSON.stringify(list));
} catch (err) {
    java.log("登录UI未初始化保存数据：" + err);
}
src;
</js>

ruleBookInfo.author: @get:{a}
ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var bookid = baseUrl.match(/novel\/(\d+)/)[1];
//书评发送
const bookva = book.getVariable("custom");
if (bookva && bookva != "") {
    if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
        const commenturl = `${GetUL()}/home/comment/add.html`;
        let body = `content=${bookva}&type=novel&mid=${bookid}`;
        
        try {
            const code = String(java.getVerificationCode(`data:image/svg+xml;base64,${codesvg}`));
            
            if (code == "评论" || /^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                if (/^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                    body += `&pid=${code.match(/(\d+)/)[1]}`;
                }
                
                const headers = { "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest" };
                const response = java.post(commenturl, body, headers).body();
                java.toast(JSON.parse(response).msg);
            } else {
                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(40);
                java.toast('请按图片要求填写');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            java.log(err);
        }
    } else {
        java.toast("未登录，请登录后操作");
    }
    book.putCustomVariable("");
}

try {
    sourceinfo = source.getLoginInfoMap();
    sourceinfo['书籍ID'] = bookid;
    if (bookid) {
        source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(sourceinfo));
    }
    $ = _ => String(java.getString(_));
    img = /^https?/.test($('[property$=image]@content')) ? $('[property$=image]@content') : GetUL() + $('[property$=image]@content');
    list = {
        "ID": bookid,
        "img": img,
        "name": $('[property$=book_name]@content'),
        "author": $('[property$=author]@content'),
        "info": $('[property$=description]@content').slice(0, 45),
        "url": "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src=" + baseUrl
    }
    source.put("list", JSON.stringify(list));
} catch (err) {
    java.log("登录UI未初始化保存数据：" + err);
}
src;
</js>

<js>
var Proxy = Map('代理：').split(",");
headers={
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/127.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36 EdgA/127.0.0.0",
    "Cookie": cache.get(java.md5Encode16(Get('url') + "cookie")) || cookie.getCookie(Get('url')),
    "proxy": Proxy.some(value => parseInt(value, 10) == parseInt(Get('ci0'), 10)) ? '' : Proxy[0],
}
cache.put(java.md5Encode16(Get('url') + "headers"),JSON.stringify(headers));
JSON.stringify(headers);
</js>
